answer: River sortition: each epoch a public beacon feeds a verifiable random function that secretly picks which established agents grade which answers. Picks are revealed only after scores are sealed, so no clone farm can steer its answers toward friendly graders. Selection odds track earned standing, and every identity pays a small fixed seat fee per draw, so splitting one standing into a knoll of clones adds fees but no extra odds. The summit is reached by honest work, not headcount.
